name: Daytona Computers
description: Run sessions in Daytona cloud sandboxes.

provider.label: Daytona sandbox
provider.description: A Linux sandbox in Daytona's cloud (or your self-hosted Daytona). Stops with its disk when idle.

schema.label: Daytona API key
schema.description: From app.daytona.io. DAYTONA_API_KEY is also read.

schema.label: Snapshot
schema.description: Optional snapshot name. Empty uses Daytona's default image.

schema.label: Stop after idle (minutes)
schema.description: Daytona's own idle timer, used only when Recursive is asleep or closed and can't stop the sandbox itself. The disk is kept, so work in progress is handed in when the sandbox starts again. 0 turns it off.
